title: Deodorant Refillable Case + YOU Refill Set

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Deodorant & Antiperspirant > Body Care > Bath & Body

descriptionHtml:
✓ allure 2024 Best of Beauty Award Winner✓ Refill Available

What it is: An aluminum-free deodorant stick with a coconut oil base and a refillable deodorant case.


Fragrance Family: Warm & Spicy


Scent Type: Warm & Sheer


Key Notes: Pink Pepper, Iris, Ambrox


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Coconut Oil: Skin-conditioning base.

- Superfruit Elderberry Extract: Provides soothing, moisturizing, and calming properties.

- Potato Starch: Naturally derived ingredients absorb moisture, helping pits feel dryer.


How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Swipe on clean, dry underarms one to two times. Reapply as needed.

Refill Product Instructions:
-The deodorant case is refillable.
-Once done with product, simply twist and pull to pop out the used Glossier deodorant stick and pop a new one into the refillable case.
Ingredients+

-Coconut Oil: Skin-conditioning base.

-Superfruit Elderberry Extract: Provides soothing, moisturizing, and calming properties.

-Potato Starch: Naturally derived ingredients absorb moisture, helping pits feel dryer.



Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Solanum Tuberosum (Potato) Starch, Coco-Caprylate/Caprate, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Wax, Carthamus Tinctorius (Safflower) Seed Oil, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Triethyl Citrate, Zinc Ricinoleate, Magnesium Hydroxide, Lauryl Laurate, Fragrance/Parfum, Sambucus Nigra Fruit Extract, Glyceryl Laurate, Salvia Officinalis (Sage) Oil, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Glyceryl Caprylate, Glyceryl Undecylenate, Sodium Caproyl/Lauroyl Lactylate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Linalool.
